    EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_brick_without_filtration_approximations

    One stable brick with neither left nor right filtration approximations #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_stable_brick_without_filtration_approximations {R : Type u} [Ring R] (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsArtinianRing R] (hn : ¬IsEFinite R) :
    ∃ (g : ProjectiveClass R) (B : FGModuleCat R), ((projectiveClassWeight k) g).IsStable B ∧ IsBrick B ∧ ¬CovariantlyFinite (FilteredBy B) ∧ ¬ContravariantlyFinite (FilteredBy B)

    Over every field an E-infinite algebra has a stable brick at an integral projective weight whose filtration category admits neither approximation property.
